rationale: Second scenario for the same obligation, covering the consequence the first check left open: the leftover bytes of a truncated value shift the stream, so the next command in the same buffer decodes to garbage. The harness writes a 70000-byte value followed by a small command and decodes both in order; the local construction run shows the second command with op 197, an arbitrary key and a 53198-byte value, with 12341 bytes remaining, so the trust the codec places in the length field destroys the following command as well. The trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review decide the formal outcome.
